-# Idempotent: uses 'git apply --reverse --check' to detect whether the patch is

-    # GIT_FOUND / GIT_EXECUTABLE are set by find_package(Git) in version.cmake,

-    # Check whether the patch is already applied by attempting a dry-run reverse.
-    # Exit code 0  → reverse applies cleanly → patch IS already applied → skip.
-    # Exit code ≠ 0 → reverse fails           → patch is NOT yet applied → apply it.
-    # Patch not yet applied — apply it now.
-    # -c core.autocrlf=false: patch files on Windows may have CRLF line endings;
-    # disabling autocrlf makes git apply agnostic of the patch file's line endings.

-# Protobuf's JSON UntypedMessage stores a std::variant (which holds UntypedMessage

-# traits on the value_type at class instantiation, which requires the still-incomplete
-# UntypedMessage to be complete and breaks Clang + libstdc++ builds. Use a node-based
-# std::map, which accepts the incomplete mapped type.

-Subject: [PATCH] Fix Abseil 20250127 compile-time constexpr failures on some GCC
-Abseil 20250127 (bundled with protobuf 6.31 and fetched via FetchContent when no
-system Abseil is available, e.g. when cross-compiling or on RHEL8) fails to
-compile with several GCC versions because of two unrelated constant-expression
-issues. Both are compiler bugs; upstream Abseil keeps the same code, so OpenVINO
-   member compares the address of the function template `TypeErasedApplyToSlotFn`
-   against nullptr, which those GCCs reject in a core constant expression:
-     hash_policy_traits.h:163: error: '(... == 0)' is not a constant expression
-   Making `value` `static const` keeps the exact same semantics (a once-
-   initialized function-local static) without forcing constant evaluation.
-   of AsciiStrCaseFold, which performs several `static_cast<char>(v)` conversions
-   with v > 127. Those implementation-defined conversions are rejected in a
-   constant expression by some GCC versions (e.g. RHEL8):
-     ascii.cc: error: non-constant condition for static assertion
-     ascii.cc: error: overflow in constant expression
-   The self-test has no runtime effect (upstream Abseil CI already covers it), so
-   remove the ValidateAsciiCasefold() helper and its static_assert.

-Subject: [PATCH] cmake: apply OpenVINO abseil source fix when fetching Abseil
-Protobuf downloads Abseil via FetchContent when it is not found locally (e.g.
-when cross-compiling, where no target-arch Abseil package is available). The
-bundled Abseil 20250127 fails to compile with some GCC versions because
-whose initializer compares a function-template address against nullptr.
-Attach a PATCH_COMMAND to the Abseil FetchContent_Declare so the OpenVINO source
-fix is applied at populate time. The helper script and patch live in OpenVINO's
-thirdparty/protobuf/patches directory, referenced relative to this file so it
-works for both the main build and the native host protoc build.
-       # When protobuf_INSTALL is enabled and Abseil will be built as a module,
-UntypedMessage declares `absl::flat_hash_map<int32_t, Value> fields_` as a member,
-where Value is a std::variant that holds UntypedMessage itself (both singular and
-trivial-type traits (e.g. is_trivially_copyable) on the map's value_type at class
-instantiation to decide slot relocation. That forces the variant's alternatives to
-be complete, including the singular UntypedMessage alternative - which is impossible
-inside UntypedMessage's own definition. Clang with libstdc++ evaluates these traits
-    type_traits: error: incomplete type 'UntypedMessage' used in type trait expression
-    variant: error: ... must be initialized by a constant expression
-A node-based std::map does not perform this relocation-trait probing, so it accepts
-an incomplete mapped type at member-declaration time. The field is only looked up by
-number (order-independent), so std::map is a drop-in replacement.
-those structs are only forward-declared (they are defined in field_common.h).
-Abseil's open-addressing containers compute trivial-type traits on the map's
-value_type at class instantiation, which requires the value type to be complete.
-Clang with libstdc++ evaluates these eagerly and fails to build:
-    stl_pair.h: error: field has incomplete type 'FieldGeneratorInfo'
-Include field_common.h so both structs are complete at the point of the map
